_about: The measurements the docs quote; scripts/bench_docs.py writes them into README.md and docs/BENCH.md. market: the Agent PR Index scan (scripts/agent_pr_index.py). chain: compute units of the two deployments' committed test builds in LiteSVM, as tests/test_oidc2_chain.py, tests/test_pay2_chain.py, tests/test_oidc_chain.py, tests/test_pay_chain.py and tests/test_oidc_gate.py print them with `pytest -q -s`, and the escrows' last random walks. devnet: what was read from devnet; `stats` holds what the release takes from the site's stats.json. release: numbers the release run measured itself (scripts/bench_docs.py --set). stages: the six stages of a payment as scripts/latency_stages.py measured them on the relay log and devnet (`--separate --write` keeps them). decision: `knos decide` timed on one machine (`local`, scripts/decide_bench.py --write) and the last release run's sample on devnet (`devnet`, entered from that run's report).

second.build: the committed test builds in `tests/fixtures` (`knos_oidc_v2_test.so`, `knos_pay_v2_test.so`), made by cargo build-sbf 3.0.0 (platform-tools v1.51)

merge_to_paid.definition: seconds from the merge (GitHub's merged_at of the pull request) to the block time of the Solana transaction that paid, one sample per successful pay line of the public relay log, over its newest 500 such lines, both deployments, all time. A line is left out when the chain's history that was read does not show its transaction or GitHub does not give the merge time; `not_timed` counts those. p50 is the median, p95 and p90 are by nearest rank

the start of the run to the token's comment
the token's comment to a relay taking it up
pickup to the block of the first transaction
that block to the block of the paying transaction
the last confirmation to the cluster finalizing it
